from pathlib import Path
import json
home=Path.home()
p=home/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees/DEV-PRED-A2Z-REPAIR-BLOCKER-20261005-E046/diagnostic-result/repair-blocker.json'
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
    raise RuntimeError('REPAIR_EVIDENCE_MISSING')
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
models=r.get('visible_models',[])
sol=[m for m in models if str(m.get('display_name')).strip().casefold()=='gpt-5.6 sol']
astra=[m for m in models if str(m.get('display_name')).strip().casefold()=='gpt-6 astra']
repair=r.get('states',{}).get('repair',{})
errors=[e for row in r.get('events',[]) if row.get('task')=='repair' for e in row.get('errors',[]) if 'ERROR=' in e or 'Error' in e]
reason=r.get('reason','UNKNOWN')
if reason!='SHARED_COORDINATOR_OUTSIDE_SCOPE' and errors:
    reason=errors[-1][-135:]
summary={'reason':reason,'repair':repair.get('status','UNKNOWN'),'sol':len(sol),'astra':len(astra),'patched':r.get('repair_source_sha256')=='d8fc774c936c92e4e5bc65cd600f7106774f3233b0e0f5555e02e2223962198e'}
out=Path.cwd()/'diagnostic-result'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'readiness.json').write_text(json.dumps({'summary':summary,'source_ref':str(p),'postbuild_gate':'FAIL','full_chain_pass':False},indent=2))
print('A2Z_READINESS '+json.dumps(summary,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
